newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac guarantees traditional French pensions.
newsitem.headline: Chirac guarantees traditional French pensions.

text.p: President Jacques Chirac told his cabinet on Wednesday that plans for private pension funds in France did not threaten the country's traditional, pay-as-you-go pension system, government spokesman Alain Lamassoure said on Wednesday.
"The distribution system is the foundation of our retirements. We are not considering questioning them and I am their guarantor," Lamassoure quoted Chirac as saying.
He said the planned private pension funds "do not at all threaten the distribution system" of retirement pensions.
"This is a socially and economically useful and modern reform. It was discussed over a long period of time. It thus prepares the future," Lamassoure said, still quoting Chirac.
Chirac said the reform would help create jobs by improving investment.
